connector.name: Signal Relay
connector.registryDescription: Connect AI agents to SocioLogic's synthetic persona platform for market research.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.sociologic.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package signal-relay-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sociologicai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
